notification.long-break-complete: Long break over! Ready for a new cycle?
notification.work-complete: Work session complete! Time for a break.

auto-start-breaks.description: Automatically start break timer after work session
auto-start-breaks.label: Auto-start Breaks

auto-start-work.description: Automatically start work timer after break
auto-start-work.label: Auto-start Work

bypass-noctalia-sound-globals.description: Play the alarm through ffplay instead of the shell's mixer, so it is heard even when sounds are disabled in Noctalia's config/GUI. Requires ffplay. Applies to the alarm only - tick/tock always go through the shell mixer and need Noctalia's global sounds enabled.
bypass-noctalia-sound-globals.label: Bypass Noctalia Sound Globals

enable-work-timer-sound.description: Play tick/tock sounds each second while a work session is running. Break timers stay silent.
enable-work-timer-sound.label: Enable Work Timer Sound

long-break-duration.description: Duration of long breaks in minutes
long-break-duration.label: Long Break Duration

notify-on-expiry.description: Also send a desktop notification when a work session or break finishes.
notify-on-expiry.label: Notify When Timer Ends

open-panel-on-expiry.description: Pop the timer panel open when a work session or break finishes, so the end of a stage is visible even if notifications are muted.
open-panel-on-expiry.label: Show Panel When Timer Ends

sessions-before-long-break.description: Number of sessions before a long break
sessions-before-long-break.label: Sessions Before Long Break

short-break-duration.description: Duration of short breaks in minutes
short-break-duration.label: Short Break Duration

use-bundled-alarm-sound.description: Play the bundled alarm sound when a work session or break is over. Silence the default notification sound with filters if you don't want both.
use-bundled-alarm-sound.label: Use Bundled Alarm Sound

glyph-break.description: Name of the icon that appears during a break.
glyph-break.label: Break Icon

glyph-main.description: Name of the icon that appears when idle.
glyph-main.label: Main Icon

glyph-work.description: Name of the icon that appears when working.
glyph-work.label: Work Icon

work-duration.description: Duration of each work session in minutes
work-duration.label: Work Duration
